profile.title: Profile
profile.noTransactionsYet: No transactions yet. Tap + New transaction to start.

display.idrHint: Foreign-currency transactions and accounts show their IDR-converted amount as the primary line, with the native amount underneath. Off by default — native amounts only.

security.biometricHint: Require Face ID / Touch ID / fingerprint to open Compass on this device. Web ignores the toggle.
security.encryptedCacheHint: Encrypt local data on this device.

notifications.permissionDeniedBody: Compass needs notification permission to send reminders. Open your device's Settings → Notifications → Compass to enable.

daily.label: Daily logging reminder
daily.hint: A nudge to log today's expenses, sent once a day at the time you pick.
daily.notifBody: How did the day go? Open Compass to log your transactions.

budget.label: Budget alerts
budget.hint: Notify when a category crosses your monthly limit threshold.
budget.notifBody: You're at {{percent}}% of your {{categoryName}} budget — {{spent}} of {{limit}}.

goal.label: Goal deadline reminders
goal.hint: Remind me 7 days and 1 day before each goal's target date.
goal.notifBody7d: {{goalName}} target is in 7 days. You've saved {{progress}} of {{target}}.
goal.notifBody1d: {{goalName}} target is tomorrow. You've saved {{progress}} of {{target}}.

account.deleteHelp: Permanently delete all your Compass data.
account.deleteConfirmBody: All accounts, transactions, budgets, and categories will be deleted. Your sign-in is removed too. This cannot be undone.
account.requiresRecentLoginBody: Your data has been deleted, but for security we couldn't fully remove your sign-in. Please sign in once more with the same email, then tap Delete account again to finish.

lockScreen.title: Compass is locked
lockScreen.body: Confirm it's you to continue. You can sign out below if biometrics aren't available right now.
